name: Generic 58mm ESC/POS printer
notes: Fits most 203dpi 58mm printers, including small portable ones. Most have a tear bar, not a cutter.
QR codes are sent as images because many 58mm printers lack the native QR command. Try `print-to-thermal set qr native` if yours has it.
Run `print-to-thermal calibrate` to measure the real print width.
